data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool error. coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review .gitignore due to a transient LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors to prevent non-critical file failures from cascading into an overall 'inconclusive' verdict.
